# FLX-4001: declared zone is outside the document's allowed zones

**Family:** governance/sovereignty (the 4000 band)

World.spec.sovereignty / Simulation.spec.sovereignty (schema $defs/sovereignty) declares the zones a run may execute in. The run's own declared zone -- the --zone flag, falling back to FLUX_ZONE -- was resolved and it is not a member of allowedZones. Under enforcement: block (the default) the run refuses to start; under enforcement: audit it does not, and a lineage-style row is recorded instead.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-4001
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
